subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should this Claude provider-native harness be an externally maintained plugin, or should OpenClaw adopt the harness and bridge package as a bundled, security-reviewed product surface?
rationale: The code can be repaired, but automation cannot choose who owns the executable, credentials and tool boundary, compatibility contract, release process, and long-term maintenance burden.

options.title: External plugin
options.body: Publish the harness and bridge through npm/ClawHub and upstream only the smallest generic plugin SDK seams that external implementation demonstrably needs.

options.title: Adopt and bundle
options.body: Transfer the bridge to OpenClaw ownership and require SQLite state, dependency and security approval, upgrade proof, and narrower core changes before merge.

options.title: Stop this direction
options.body: Close the implementation and invest in existing Anthropic provider, Claude CLI, or ACP reliability paths instead.

recommendation.title: External plugin
recommendation.body: Publish the harness and bridge through npm/ClawHub and upstream only the smallest generic plugin SDK seams that external implementation demonstrably needs.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history connects this owner to the generic harness auth, plugin SDK, storage, and delivery boundaries whose permanent direction must be chosen.
